title: PowerToys Run: one-off startup crash – PowerToys.ManagedCommon 0.98.1.0 not found
author: boardtc

judgment.rationale: The one-off assembly-load failure occurred on an old mixed 0.98.0/0.98.1 installation and PowerToys subsequently worked normally. The existing upstream triage request already asks the reporter to update to the current stable release and confirm whether the issue reproduces.
evidence: The exception requests PowerToys.ManagedCommon 0.98.1.0 while the crash report identifies PowerToys 0.98.0.0.
The reporter says the error occurred once and PowerToys continued to work normally afterward.
No reliable reproduction steps or diagnostic archive are available.
The issue is labeled Needs-Author-Feedback, and the automated upstream triage comment asks for current-version confirmation and reproduction details.
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for the reporter to test the current stable release and provide fresh evidence if the assembly mismatch recurs.

fix_assessment.rationale: The available evidence points to a transient mixed-version installation from an obsolete release. A current repository fix cannot be selected until recurrence on a supported version or installation diagnostics identify an active servicing defect.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys Run failed once because a 0.98.0 process requested a 0.98.1 ManagedCommon assembly, then resumed working normally. The issue is waiting for confirmation on the current stable release.
known_information: The exception is a FileNotFoundException for PowerToys.ManagedCommon version 0.98.1.0.
The crash metadata reports PowerToys version 0.98.0.0.
PowerToys was installed through auto-update and had worked on the machine for about a year.
The event is not reliably reproducible and no bug-report ZIP is attached.
An upstream automated triage comment has already requested reproduction details and an update to the latest stable release.
inferences: A partial or interrupted historical update may have temporarily mixed binaries from 0.98.0 and 0.98.1, but this is not confirmed.
Because the application subsequently worked, the mismatched state may already have self-repaired or been transient.
issue_context.analysis: The assembly versions provide a strong historical servicing signal but not a current actionable code path. Repeating the existing information request would add noise. The correct dashboard state is waiting on the already-posted author request, with re-triage if the problem reproduces on the current release.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body, labels, and existing automated triage response.
Confirmed that the only concrete failure evidence is a mixed 0.98.0/0.98.1 assembly version and that the issue supplies no repeatable trigger.
No linked current fix attempt or duplicate is present in the issue timeline.

information_gaps.information: Whether the failure reproduces after updating to the current stable PowerToys release.
information_gaps.why_needed: This determines whether an active servicing or binding defect remains.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Update to the latest stable release and report whether PowerToys Run fails again.

information_gaps.information: A fresh diagnostic archive captured immediately after any recurrence.
